INFORMATION & POLICIES

Privacy policy

We use the details you submit to review and respond to service enquiries or job applications. Customer enquiries and candidate applications are handled separately.

When online submissions are connected, records and attachments are stored in our private company Google Drive, accessible to authorised staff. Until then, please contact us by email; the website does not confirm an online save.

To request access, correction or deletion of your details, contact admin@tristone.ae. Please avoid uploading information that is not needed for your enquiry or application.
